description: Full details of one of the user's own projects, as the Studio editor shows them: every field, the roles with pay and their application counts, the publish checklist with the tool that completes each open item, whether it can be published, previous work and the films that could be listed as previous work, and the public and Studio links. Only the owner can read a project this way; anyone else's answers not found.

project_id.description: The project's id (from list_projects or create_project).
